basic_details.job_title: KVS AFS Amla Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for Primary Teacher, PGT Hindi and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The walk-in interview for KVS Recruitment 2026 will be conducted on 27 October 2026 at 09:00 AM at PM Shri Kendriya Vidyalaya AFS Amla, District - Betul, Madhya Pradesh 460553. The interview is being organized to prepare a contractual teacher panel for the posts of Trained Graduate Teacher (Hindi), Primary Teacher (English), and Vocational Instructor with consolidated monthly remuneration up to Rs. 26,250/-.

age_limit.details: Minimum and maximum age limit shall be 18 and 65 years respectively.

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: Bachelor's Degree with at least 50% marks in the concerned subject, B.Ed., and CTET qualified, along with competence in computer teaching and proficiency to teach through English medium (as per KVS rules)

Senior Secondary School Certificate (+2) with at least 50% marks and JBT/D.Ed/PTC (2-year course), along with competence in computer teaching and proficiency to teach through English medium (CTET Paper-I qualified as per KVS rules)

B.E. or B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering from a recognized university, or B.Tech. with experience in Electronics and Robotics, with proficiency to teach through English medium (as per KVS rules)

content_sections.heading: KVS Recruitment 2026 Walk-in Interview Date, Time and Venue
content_sections.text: Register for Job Alerts The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies or the application fee. PM Shri Kendriya Vidyalaya AFS Amla is a central government school located at Air Force Station Amla in Betul district, Madhya Pradesh, functioning under the Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan. The school conducts this walk-in selection to empanel qualified teachers purely on a part-time contractual basis for the 2026-27 academic session. All appointments are temporary and intended to manage academic requirements without conferring any right to regular employment.

content_sections.heading: KVS Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The duties and responsibilities assigned to contractual teachers and instructors in the Vidyalaya include: Regular classroom teaching activity and student notebook or assignment checking. Invigilation duty and examination evaluation work as scheduled by the Vidyalaya. Assisting students and colleagues in the preparation and organization of various curricular and co-curricular activities. Taking care of the functioning, daily management, monitoring, maintenance of laboratory setups (including Atal Tinkering Labs/ATL), robotics activities, and assisting in hackathons for vocational instructors. All other administrative or academic work assigned by the Principal.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Candidates attending the walk-in interview must report in person with the following documents: A printed copy of the fully completed online application form. Original educational qualification certificates and mark sheets (Class 10, Class 12, Graduation, Professional degrees, and CTET mark sheets/certificates). Original experience certificates from recognized institutions, if applicable (experience entered must not be less than 6 months or more than 3 years). One complete set of self-attested photocopies of all original mark sheets, certificates, and testimonials. Recent passport-size photographs. Original valid photo identity proof containing residential address (such as Voter ID Card, Aadhaar Card, or other valid government photo ID).

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: The selection process on 27 October 2026 follows these stages: Candidates must report at PM Shri Kendriya Vidyalaya AFS Amla at 09:00 AM for physical attendance and initial verification of the application printout and original identity documents. Document verification will be conducted to confirm the basic eligibility criteria for the respective post. If more than 10 eligible candidates report for any single post, the Vidyalaya may organize a written screening test to shortlist candidates. Eligible or shortlisted candidates will then appear before the interview panel. The interview process may continue until late in the evening. No travel allowance or daily allowance (TA/DA) will be paid for attending the test or interview.

faq.question: Q1. When will the walk-in interview for KVS Recruitment 2026 be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted on 27 October 2026 starting from 09:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. What is the venue for the KVS Recruitment 2026 interview?
faq.answer: The interview will take place at PM Shri Kendriya Vidyalaya AFS Amla, District - Betul, Madhya Pradesh 460553.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to register online before the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must complete their online registration on the designated portal by 25 October 2026 up to 8:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for KVS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Minimum and maximum age limit shall be 18 and 65 years respectively.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly salary for the contractual posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration is Rs. 26,250/- per month for TGT (Hindi), Rs. 21,250/- per month for PRT (English), and Rs. 21,250/- to Rs. 25,000/- per month for Vocational Instructor.

faq.question: Q6. What should candidates do if they face technical problems registering online?
faq.answer: Candidates facing technical issues on the portal can email their completed application form to [email protected] by 25 October 2026 up to 8:00 PM.

faq.question: Q7. Will there be a written exam for this recruitment?
faq.answer: A written test may be conducted on the interview day if more than 10 candidates appear for a particular post.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates without CTET qualification apply?
faq.answer: In the absence of CTET-qualified candidates, candidates without CTET qualification may be considered if they are otherwise eligible as per KVS rules.

faq.question: Q9. Is this appointment permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: The appointment is purely on a part-time contractual basis to form a panel for the 2026-27 session and confers no right to regular employment.
